descriptions.sol31a_reset_motion_800d2f64: Loads motion parameters through the handle at +136, calls the table+32 phase with zero, initializes the direction and translated position vectors, copies paired rate and flag fields, clears velocity and acceleration, adds the parameter angle and the original single-precision pi constant to the owner angle, then resolves the output angle and height through 0x800d4b90. All layouts describe the GC32 reference ABI only.
